content:
We're gearing up to bring you the 9to5Toys lunch break weekend edition. This round of deals arrives in tandem with Amazon's massive 2026 Labor Day blowout, plus AirPods Pro 3 are still down by $50, and AirTag 2 has hit a historic low of $20 each.

Other highlights include the iPhone 17 Pro at its all-time low — up to $290 off the latest pricing — alongside the first discounts on Apple's all-new M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini. Check out the roundup below — you'll also find plenty of deals on accessories, chargers and smart home gear.
